title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented gain-scheduled LQR with anti-windup for actuator saturation at ±0.9. Designed LQR controllers at 4 operating points, implemented linear interpolation for gain scheduling, and created anti-windup compensation. Simulation demonstrates stable closed-loop performance. H-infinity norm analysis shows the standard LQR design with given weights does not meet the requirement of ||T_zw||_∞ < 1.0 at any operating point. Comprehensive report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion generated in report/report.md.
